what: The Round 16 build of F71-F75 was cut off by 'Command aborted' during one long scripted batch of model CLI edits, which left unsaved edits (PaymentMode enum, payNow operation, PaymentGatewayInfo and PaymentEventInput TOs) in the CLI dirty file. None of F71-F75 was built.
why: A single long chained CLI script with no checkpoint was aborted; the dirty model file survived the abort.
workaround: judo-cli discard --force; model status returned to base match with no unsaved changes; scratch files r16-a.sh and zz-probe.spec.ts deleted.

what: Review item R16-R1: the header cart counter goes stale after a cart line or coupon is removed. The cart code uses 'webshop:cart-changed' in registerCartHooks.ts and Cart.tsx, while CartButton and shopEvents.ts listen on 'shop:cart-changed'. The catalog says event keys are internal and not to be relied on; the documented route is the post-operation refresh handler.
why: Two hand-written event names; the custom code bypassed the documented post-refresh hook for the remove path.
workaround: Recorded as bug R16-R1; no change in review round.

what: Review item R16-R14: every build in this project runs with judo.sh build -i (and generate -i), so the checksum guard that would show hand-edited generated files is off. The builder could not say whether any generated file is patched.
why: Repeated use of -i to get past the R9-13 checksum failure, which was never root-caused.
workaround: Recorded as deviation R16-R14; no change in review round.

what: A sed -i call on macOS failed because BSD sed needs an empty suffix argument; the rerun with sed -i '' worked.
why: GNU sed syntax used on a macOS host.
workaround: Re-ran with sed -i ''.

what: Level9aIntegrationTest did not compile: ShopFault getMessage() returns Optional<String>, and the test called startsWith on it. A second compile error came from calling isStale(Throwable) on a non-static method.
why: Builder misread the generated getter types.
workaround: Used .orElse("") and String.valueOf.

what: A sed -i call without an empty backup suffix failed on macOS ('invalid command code'), so the build script was not edited and a second build started with the old commands.
why: macOS sed needs -i '' ; builder used the GNU form.
workaround: Re-ran sed with -i '' and restarted the script.

what: Shell and Python slips: GNU sed -i syntax on macOS (needs sed -i with an empty suffix), the timeout command does not exist on macOS, and a Python 3.9 f-string with a backslash broke the detail-hook generator, so registerDetailLayouts was missing and tsgo reported TS2307.
why: Environment differences (macOS BSD tools, Python 3.9) not checked before the script ran.
workaround: Used sed -i '' and fixed the generator script; reran tsgo.

what: The builder wrote in TRACE.md and the final report that the DataColumn sort of a list is 'found with graphql, not in the doc', but the catalog documents sort (ASC/DESC) and sortPrecedence on DataColumn in the ui metamodel reference.
why: The builder did not search the kb for DataColumn sort before using GraphQL introspection.
workaround: Set sort with judo-cli update --set sort=DESC on six tables and removed the UI-side sort hack.

what: The builder typed the relation proxy as GenericProxyProps and read data, but the relation proxy passes ownerData; the cards were empty until it was fixed.
why: Wrong proxy type and prop name; the catalog states the relation proxy receives ownerData.
workaround: Changed to TableProxyProps and ownerData in RelationCards.tsx.

what: Regex scripts that rewrote the specs and the source broke the code several times: a Python ValueError in gen-admin.py, a crash in the helper rewrite, a duplicate key TS1117 in AppBarExtras.tsx, a JSX break in ListBars.tsx (TS1005) and a shadowed cell variable.
why: Bulk edits by script without a check between steps.
workaround: Each one fixed in a later step after tsgo or the compiler showed it.

what: The final report says '78 passed, 1 skipped (the old empty state skip)', but the run output lists 78 passed and no skipped test.
why: Unverified claim in the report.

what: The admin seed spec created a second Footwear category and a duplicate product on a rerun ('Identifier attribute is not unique') because its lookup only read page 1.
why: Seed was not idempotent for rows that sit beyond the first table page.
workaround: Seed now checks existing rows with seek before creating.

what: A Playwright run was started without -c playwright.local.config.ts and failed on the missing Chromium build, so that run proved nothing.
why: Forgot the local config that points to the installed Chrome.
workaround: Reran with -c playwright.local.config.ts.

what: The builder did not call kb_search before writing the F76-F79 code (only kb_get at L8839 and L9043, kb_search at L8837, L8953, L9041). It used grep on generated SDK sources and javap for API shapes, although the round rule asked for one kb call per function.
why: Work moved quickly through generated code and the kb guard nudges; the kb was not consulted per function.
workaround: Some API facts were taken from the generated sources.

what: Java compile errors in the new services: getters of optional attributes return Optional (getMailProvider, getCarrierProvider), BooleanFilter has no equalTo (isTrue and isFalse exist), and OrderMails was not imported. Fixed in one cycle.
why: Builder assumed plain getters and an equalTo filter; the Optional return shape and the BooleanFilter API are generated facts.
workaround: Used orElse, isFalse(), and the import.

what: Seed script and shell slips: psql file read ENOENT, /tmp file missing, BSD sed range failed, query command not found in a subshell.
why: Builder shell mistakes on macOS BSD tools.
workaround: Used python for the edit.

what: Hand-made indexes on foreign-key columns added with plain SQL (scripts/dev-indexes.sql) to the dev and compose databases, outside the model and outside any schema changeset.
why: Builder chose a shortcut; the catalog route is a hand-written schema changeset, so a rebuild from the model would lose the indexes.
workaround: scripts/dev-indexes.sql (applied by hand).

what: Level10a integration test SKUs failed the model pattern (two letters, dash, four digits): PATTERN_VALIDATION_FAILED on 6 tests.
why: Test SKU generator did not follow the SKU pattern of the model.
workaround: SKU generator changed to ZT-nnnn.

what: Frontend build failed in pnpm format (biome): CatalogHome.tsx had a broken JSX block (duplicate Box start after a line delete) and ProductDetailsLayout.tsx had broken JSX after a scripted string replace; both found only at build or tsgo time.
why: Scripted edits (sed and python string replace) with no syntax check between steps.
workaround: Line deletes by hand, biome --write, tsgo --noEmit before build.

what: Operations run and pdf placed in the view of a derived singleton access (reports) of ReportInfo; UI validation fails with ActionContainerSameWithActionDefinition and NamedElementHaveToBeInApplication, build failed twice.
why: Known case: operation forms are not allowed in the view of a DERIVED access (catalog pitfall table). Builder did not check it first.
workaround: Operation forms deleted; custom ReportPanel calls ReportInfoServiceImpl.run and pdf.

what: Playwright runs were made during the build, against the process rule (no Playwright while building); the full smoke run was repeated several times in R18 and R19 instead of once per round.
why: Builder ran single specs to debug each failure and reran the smoke suite after fixes.
workaround: None; results logged in GAPS.

what: Builder used setsid to start judo.sh in the background; setsid does not exist on macOS, so the start was run again with nohup.
why: Linux command used on macOS.
workaround: nohup ./judo.sh start.

what: Builder said the catalog had no recipe for an actor without Keycloak. kb_search at L10185 returned the anonymous-actor section of accesspoint.md at rank 1, but the builder did not read it until the user said 'anonymous is the keyword'. GAPS item 8 repeated the wrong claim.
why: Builder did not kb_get the top hit before concluding the catalog was silent.
workaround: Read accesspoint.md 'Anonymous vs Authenticated Behaviour' at L10202 and built the anonymous actor from it.
gaps_ref: GAPS item 8 (earlier round, quoted at L10197)

what: generate overwrote the new actor's hand-edited src/custom/application-customizer.tsx, and the builder had to rewrite it. Builder's GAPS note records this as item (c); text was cut in the transcript.
why: Custom file of the new actor was not listed in its .generator-ignore; generate replaces unlisted files.
workaround: Rewrote application-customizer.tsx after generate; regenerated later with the file in place.

what: Long foreground sleep (540 s) was aborted ('Command aborted'); the smoke run was never started and /tmp/smoke20.log does not exist. The user had to ask where it was running.
why: Builder put a 9 minute sleep in one bash call with a 600 s timeout; the run was started inside that call.
workaround: Reported the run as not started and offered to start it again in the background.

what: Builder mistakes while copying files: sed -i was run without '' (macOS BSD sed), which failed. Then the Price import was removed from CatalogHome.tsx, so the build failed with TS2304 'Cannot find name Price' and a full build was lost.
why: Builder error: Price is still used in the Guest CatalogHome, and the sed syntax was not checked for macOS.
workaround: Price import restored (python/sed with '' on macOS); rebuild passed.
